title: U.S. Physical Therapy Announces the Appointment of New Board Member Myra Davis
summary: HOUSTON, September 21, 2026--U.S. Physical Therapy, Inc. ("USPH" or the "Company") (NYSE, NYSE Texas: USPH), a national operator of outpatient physical therapy clinics and provider of industrial injury prevention services, today announced that its Board of Directors (the "Board") approved the appointment of Ms. Myra Davis to serve as a member of the Board, effective October 1, 2026.

title: U.S. Physical Therapy Announces CFO
summary: HOUSTON, August 14, 2026--U.S. Physical Therapy, Inc. ("USPH" or the "Company") (NYSE, NYSE Texas: USPH), a national operator of outpatient physical therapy clinics and provider of industrial injury prevention services ("IIP"), today announced that Nchacha Etta will serve as the Company’s Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective as of September 1, 2026. Jason Curtis, the Company’s Senior Vice President, Finance and Accounting, served as Interim CFO since April 24, 2026.
